'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Mike D'Ambrosio DS 4-LOM''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike D'Ambrosio]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|4-LOM|Dagobah-D-4lom.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
